codeChange.change: In reconcileWithAtomEnvelope()'s 'no-buildable-area' branch: added isMachineVerifyDiagnostic(reason) (three independent signals -- '; ' clause-join, an 'edge N:'/'road N:' gate-diagnostic prefix, or a full-precision float with 4+ decimal places -- matching exactly how hauska-engine's honest-decline-promote.ts assembles verifyReasons.slice(0,3).join('; ')). When the atom's outcome.reason matches: (a) if derive.ts's own live pass already produced a real, non-empty envelope, keep it unchanged (same as the pre-existing 'unknown/pending kind' branch -- a stale mechanical-cert failure is not a measurement the atom can correct a good live result WITH); (b) otherwise, classify as emptyKind 'validation-failed' (not 'consumed' -- matching derive.ts's own established distinction that a validation failure is a fact about the check, never a consume-lot measurement) and substitute a fixed, honest, customer-safe disclosure instead of the raw text. A genuine human-authored engine reason (no '; ', no per-edge prefix, no long float) is unaffected -- existing behavior for that case is untouched byte-for-byte.
